rationale: Build an SBC reserve workpaper from the May and June 2025 reserve reports. Calculate coverage and residuals by economic observation date and calendar days from observation to report signature. Bridge cash, government-debt, reserve and circulation changes from May to June. Treat repeated identical exports as one report, while keeping different economic dates distinct even when their amounts are equal. Determine whether these snapshots identify payments volume.
exposure: Previously published source group, never held out
starting_defects: not applicable - no starting SQL supplied
reference_method: Independent Python Decimal calculations from source rows, separate from submitted SQL

contract_revision.changes: Explicit input database, output directory and existing basename restriction

grading_correction.changes: Correct SBC source bindings and accept known dossier context with sufficient support. No financial, source, SQL or counterfactual changes.

quality_revision.evidence: Reviewed per-output support and additional context, unrelated sections rejected

replacement_review.assertion: More SBC units were transferred in payments during June 2025 than were in circulation at the June 30 observation.
replacement_review.source_grounded_reason: The reports supply month-end issued-supply and reserve stocks. Repeated transfers can generate payment volume above supply, while few transfers can generate less. Neither payment-transfer counts nor amounts are supplied, so both outcomes remain possible with the reported stocks.

construction_revision.maintenance_rationale: A researcher needs to distinguish an economic date join defect from a valid signature-date calculation. The coverage module deliberately contains an authored synthetic join defect over authentic observations. Stock changes are useful, but are not transaction flows or evidence of historical publication timing.

claim_assertion_changes.claim_2: The June report was signed more calendar days after its economic observation than the May report.
claim_assertion_changes.claim_3: At least one observation date shows reserve assets greater than issued SBC units at USD 1 per token.

evidence_support_changes.reason: Every supplied evidence entry includes its report observation period and report_signed_date. Any May entry paired with any June entry supports the two signature lags and their comparison.

public_definitions.reserve_bridge: Changes are June less May stocks, not transaction flows. Reserve change is (June cash + June government debt) minus (May cash + May government debt). Use these component sums for the coverage change as well. Keep reported reserve fair values independent, with component sums less reported fair values as the reserve_coverage residuals. Signature lags are calendar days, not known publication delays.
